content.title: CURV Q3 Deep Dive: Merchandise Missteps, Store Closures, and Strategy Reset Dominate Quarter
content.summary: Women’s plus-size apparel retailer Torrid Holdings (NYSE:CURV) fell short of the markets revenue expectations in Q3 CY2025, with sales falling 10.8% year on year to $235.2 million. The company’s full-year revenue guidance of $998.5 million at the midpoint came in 2.2% below analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP loss of $0.06 per share was significantly below analysts’ consensus estimates.
